name: XO Mecenas
description: Recurring BCH payments: a funder pledges BCH, a recipient withdraws a capped amount once per period, and the remainder stays in the covenant. The funder can reclaim at any time.

funder.name: Funder
funder.description: Pledges BCH to the covenant and can reclaim the full balance at any time.

recipient.name: Recipient
recipient.description: Receives the capped periodic pledge. Withdrawing needs no signature: the covenant enforces the payout.

createMecenas.name: Create Mecenas Covenant
createMecenas.description: Fund a new recurring-payment covenant for a recipient, with a periodic pledge cap.

funder.name: Fund covenant
funder.description: Choose the recipient, the periodic pledge and the period length, and deposit the initial balance.

withdraw.name: Withdraw Pledge
withdraw.description: Pay the recipient the periodic pledge; the remainder continues in the same covenant. No signature required: the covenant enforces the payout.
conditions: $(OP_INPUTINDEX OP_UTXOVALUE OP_BIN2NUM <pledgeSatoshis> <pledgeSatoshis> OP_ADD <1500> OP_ADD <1500> OP_ADD OP_GREATERTHAN)

withdrawFinal.name: Withdraw Final Balance
withdrawFinal.description: The remaining balance cannot cover another pledge round: pay the recipient everything minus the miner fee and close the covenant.
conditions: $(OP_INPUTINDEX OP_UTXOVALUE OP_BIN2NUM <pledgeSatoshis> <pledgeSatoshis> OP_ADD <1500> OP_ADD <1500> OP_ADD OP_LESSTHANOREQUAL)

reclaim.name: Reclaim Balance
reclaim.description: The funder cancels the covenant and withdraws the full balance to a destination of their choice, regardless of age.

createMecenasTransaction.name: Mecenas Covenant Created
createMecenasTransaction.description: Funded a Mecenas covenant with $(<mecenasSatoshis>) satoshis, pledging up to $(<pledgeSatoshis>) satoshis every $(<periodBlocks>) blocks.

withdrawTransaction.name: Pledge Withdrawn
withdrawTransaction.description: Paid the recipient from the Mecenas covenant.

withdrawFinalTransaction.name: Covenant Closed
withdrawFinalTransaction.description: Paid the recipient the full remaining balance and closed the Mecenas covenant.

reclaimTransaction.name: Covenant Reclaimed
reclaimTransaction.description: The funder reclaimed the full Mecenas covenant balance.

withdrawInput.name: Mecenas balance
withdrawInput.description: The covenant output holding $(<mecenasSatoshis>) satoshis, aged at least $(<periodBlocks>) blocks.

initialMecenasOutput.name: Mecenas Covenant
initialMecenasOutput.description: A new covenant holding $(<mecenasSatoshis>) satoshis, pledging $(<pledgeSatoshis>) satoshis every $(<periodBlocks>) blocks.

recipientPledgeOutput.name: Recipient payout
recipientPledgeOutput.description: The recipient receives the periodic pledge, or the full remaining balance if this is the final round.

mecenasRemainderOutput.name: Mecenas Covenant (continued)
mecenasRemainderOutput.description: The remainder, minus the miner fee, stays in the same covenant for the next period.

recipientFinalOutput.name: Recipient final payout
recipientFinalOutput.description: The remaining balance cannot cover another pledge round, so the recipient receives everything minus the miner fee and the covenant closes.

funderReclaimOutput.name: Funder payout
funderReclaimOutput.description: The funder receives the full balance minus the miner fee.

mecenasScript.name: Mecenas Covenant
mecenasScript.description: Holds the pledge balance and enforces the capped periodic withdrawal or an unconditional funder reclaim.

scripts.isFinalWithdraw: OP_INPUTINDEX OP_UTXOVALUE OP_BIN2NUM <pledgeSatoshis> <pledgeSatoshis> OP_ADD <1500> OP_ADD <1500> OP_ADD OP_LESSTHANOREQUAL
scripts.enforceFinalWithdraw: OP_0 OP_OUTPUTVALUE OP_BIN2NUM OP_INPUTINDEX OP_UTXOVALUE OP_BIN2NUM <1500> OP_SUB OP_NUMEQUAL
scripts.enforcePartialWithdraw: OP_0 OP_OUTPUTVALUE OP_BIN2NUM <pledgeSatoshis> OP_NUMEQUALVERIFY OP_1 OP_OUTPUTBYTECODE OP_INPUTINDEX OP_UTXOBYTECODE OP_EQUALVERIFY OP_1 OP_OUTPUTVALUE OP_BIN2NUM OP_INPUTINDEX OP_UTXOVALUE OP_BIN2NUM <pledgeSatoshis> OP_SUB <1500> OP_SUB OP_NUMEQUAL
scripts.enforceWithdraw: enforceAge enforceSingleInput enforceRecipientOutput isFinalWithdraw OP_IF enforceFinalWithdraw OP_ELSE enforcePartialWithdraw OP_ENDIF

minerFeeSatoshis.name: Miner fee
minerFeeSatoshis.description: Fixed miner fee taken by every withdraw and used as the minimum reclaim fee. Inlined into the covenant, mirroring the hardcoded `int minerFee = 1000` in the original CashScript contract.

dustLimit.name: Dust limit
dustLimit.description: Minimum value for a payout output. Used by off-chain helpers; not separately enforced on-chain (neither is it in the original contract).

funderKey.name: Funder key
funderKey.description: The key that authorizes reclaim. Its public key hash is committed into the covenant address.

recipientLockingScript.name: Recipient destination
recipientLockingScript.description: The locking script paid the pledge on every withdrawal. Generalizes the original bytes20 P2PKH-only recipient parameter to any locking script.

pledgeSatoshis.name: Pledge
pledgeSatoshis.description: The maximum number of satoshis the recipient may withdraw per period.

periodBlocks.name: Period (blocks)
periodBlocks.description: Minimum number of blocks the covenant UTXO must age before a withdrawal (this.age >= period in the original contract).

mecenasSatoshis.name: Covenant balance
mecenasSatoshis.description: The current number of satoshis held by the covenant. Informational mirror; the authoritative balance is the UTXO value.

funderPayoutLockingScript.name: Reclaim destination
funderPayoutLockingScript.description: The locking script chosen by the funder to receive a reclaim. Freely chosen at spend time: it is not part of the covenant's committed state, matching the original contract's unconstrained reclaim() outputs.

feeSatoshis.name: Reclaim fee
feeSatoshis.description: The miner fee taken from the balance on reclaim. Freely chosen (at least the documented minimum): unlike withdraw, the covenant does not fix this value.
